vehicleNotes: 2015 Dodge Challenger SRT 392 (6.4L Hemi): This high-performance engine requires strict adherence to OEM specifications. Use ONLY 0W-40 full synthetic oil—do not substitute with 5W-30 or other viscosity weights, as this will void warranty and compromise engine protection. Total oil capacity is 7.0 quarts with filter change. Always replace the oil drain plug crush washer with each service; reusing the old washer risks oil leaks. Torque specifications are critical: drain plug to 20 ft-lbs, oil filter to 10-13 ft-lbs. All parts verified for correct fitment on this model year.
